an6.55:12.4: A mendicant with defilements ended does not see in themselves anything more to do, or anything that needs improvement. They’re dedicated to seclusion because they’re free of greed, hate, and delusion with the end of greed, hate, and delusion.
an6.55:13.4: A mendicant with defilements ended does not see in themselves anything more to do, or anything that needs improvement. They’re dedicated to kindness because they’re free of greed, hate, and delusion with the end of greed, hate, and delusion.
an6.55:17.11: Even if violent storms were to blow up out of the north …
an6.55:17.14: Their mind is quite untainted. It is steady, imperturbable, observing disappearance.
an6.55:17.19: and ideas come into the range of the mind they don’t overcome the mind.
